//: Copy the three hooks into your harness settings. The $HOME guard keeps
//2: MEMEX out of sessions opened elsewhere on the machine. Point MEMEX at
//3: your clone: replace $MEMEX_HOME below, or put bin/ on PATH.

hooks.command: case "$PWD" in "$HOME"|"$HOME"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; exec $MEMEX_HOME/bin/memex pending --nudge
